text: Whoever establishes prayers during the nights of Ramadan faithfully out of sincere faith and hoping to attain Allah's rewards, all his past sins will be forgiven.
I have been sent in the best of all the generations of Adam's offspring since their Creation.
Two Muslims will not meet and shake hands having their sins forgiven them before they separate.
He who loves to meet Allah, Allah too loves to meet him, and he who dislikes to meet Allah, Allah abhors to meet him.
The angels invoke blessings on any of you who remains sitting at the place where he says his prayers so long as he is defiled or stands up, saying: O Allah, forgives him; O Allah, have mercy on him.
He who has land should cultivate it or lend it to his brother, but if he refuses, he should retain his land.

It is not lawful for a man to desert his brother Muslim for more than three nights. when they meet, one of them turns his face away from the other, and the other turns his face from the former, and the better of the two will be the one who greets the other first.
When a man dies all his good deeds come to an end except three: Ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge and a righteous son who prays for him.
Give food to the hungry, pay a visit to the sick and release the one in captivity.

O community of people, who believed by their tongue, and belief did not enter their hearts, do not back-bite Muslims, and do not search for their faults, for if anyone searches for their faults, Allah will search for his fault, and if Allah searches for the fault of anyone, He disgraces him in his house.
Whoever loves to meet Allah, Allah loves to meet him; and whoever hates to meet Allah, Allah hates to meet him.
The best things with which grey hair are changed are henna and katam.
The most virtuous fast is the fast of my brother Dawud. He would fast a day, and not fast day. He would not flee at the time of engagement.
Allah rejoiced more over the repentance of anyone of you, then you rejoice over your lost animal when you find it.
Going out in the morning in the cause of Allah, or in the evening, is more virtuous than the world and what is in it.
If a man spends on his family sincerely for Allah's sake then it is a alms-giving in reward for him.
Allah is more delighted with the repentance of one of you, than one of you is, when finding his lost animal.

He who prayed the morning prayer he is in fact under the protection of Allah. And it can never happen that Allah should demand anything from you in connection with the protection and one should not get it. He would then throw him in the fire of Hell.
Whoso obeys me obeys God; and whose disobeys me disobeys God. Whoso obeys my commander obeys me, and whoso disobeys my commander disobeys me.

My nation was shown to me with their good deeds and bad deeds. Among their good deeds I saw a harmful thing being removed from the road. And among their bad deeds I saw sputum in the mosque that had not been removed.
The dream of a righteous Muslim man is one of the seventy parts of prophecy.

When it is hot, make delay till it cools down, for the intensity of beat is from the Exhalation of Hell; and he also mentioned that Hellfire complained to the Lord and so it was permitted to take two exhalations during the whole year, one exhalation during the winter and one exhalation during the summer.
O Allah! There is no life worth living except the life of the Hereafter, so make righteous the Ansar and the Emigrants.
Allah will give shade to seven under His Shade. a person who remembers Allah and his eyes are then flooded with tears.
If anyone drinks poison, the poison will be in his hand and he will drink it in Hell-fire and he will live in it eternally.
Amongst the people preceding you there used to be 'Muhaddithun', and if there are any such persons amongst my followers, it is `Umar bin Al-Khattab.

A man never did a good deed but removed a thorny branch from the road; it was either in the tree and someone cut it and threw it on the road, or it was lying in it, he removed it. Allah accepted this good deed of his and brought him into Paradise.
The lifelong gift is permitted for its inhabitant, and the Ruqba is permitted for its inhabitant.

The angels keep on asking for Allah's Blessing and Forgiveness for anyone of you as long as he is at his Musalla and does not do Hadath. The angels say, 'O Allah! Forgive him and be Merciful to him.' Each one of you is in the prayer as long as he is waiting for the prayer and nothing but the prayer detains him from going to his family.
The signs of a hypocrite are three: Whenever he speaks he tells a lie; whenever he is entrusted he proves dishonest; whenever he promises he breaks his promise.
The best time for a man to go in to his family on return from a journey is at the beginning of the night.
When anyone of you has finished his prayer, let him give his house a share of that, for Allah will put something good in his house because of that prayer.
The nearest a servant comes to his Lord is when he is prostrating himself, so make supplication.
An oath is to be interpreted according to the intention of the one who takes it.
Give in charity because there will come a time on the people when a person will go out with his alms from place to place but will not find anybody to accept it.
He who would get into Paradise bliss that he would neither become destitute, nor would his clothes wear out, nor his youth would decline.

Verily. Allah would say on the Day of Resurrection: Where are those who have mutual love for My Glory's sake? Today I shall shelter them in My shadow when there is no other shadow but the shadow of Mine.
In Paradise, there is a tree under the shadow of which a rider can travel for a hundred years.
If anyone says "I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion and with Muhammad ﷺ as Apostle" Paradise will be his due.
Make intercession to me, you will be rewarded, for Allah decrees what he wishes by the tongue of his prophet.

Allah loves sneezing but dislikes yawning; so if anyone of you sneezes and then praises Allah, every Muslim who hears him has to say Tashmit to him. But as regards yawning, it is from Satan, so if one of you yawns, he should try his best to stop it, for when anyone of you yawns, Satan laughs at him.
I am most akin to the son of Mary among the whole of mankind and the Prophets are of different mothers, but of one religion, and no Prophet was raised between me and him.
The journey undertaken by a person in the morning in the way of Allah better than the world and all that is in it.

If somebody sees his Muslim ruler doing something he disapproves of, he should be patient, for whoever becomes separate from the Muslim group even for a span and then dies, he will die as those who died in the Pre-lslamic period of ignorance.
The first matter concerning which judgment will be passed among the people on the Day of Resurrection will be bloodshed.
Help your brother, whether he is an oppressor or he is an oppressed one.
If I were to take a Khalil, I would have taken Abu Bakr, but he is my brother and my companion.
A Muslim is a brother of another Muslim. So he should neither oppress him nor hand him over to an oppressor. And whoever fulfilled the needs of his brother, Allah will fulfill his needs.
Indeed I hear the crying of a small boy while I am in Salat, so I shorten it in fear that his mother may be tormented.
There is no transitive disease, no divination, but I like good words.
Verily, there are one hundred mercy for Allah, and it is one part of this mercy by virtue of which there is mutual love between the people and ninety-nine reserved for the Day of Resurrection.
There would enter Paradise people whose hearts would be like those of the hearts of birds.
When any one of you eats food he should lick his fingers, for he does not know in what part of the food sticking to his fingers the blessing lies.

By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, this world will not pass away until a man will pass by a grave, and will roll on it and say: ‘Would that I were in the place of the occupant of this grave!’ And the reason for that will not be any religious motive, rather it will be because of calamity.

Allah has forbidden for you, to be undutiful to your mothers, to bury your daughters alive, to not to pay the rights of the others and to beg of men. And Allah has hated for you vain, useless talk, or that you talk too much about others, to ask too many questions, and to waste the wealth.
If only one day of this time remained, Allah would raise up a man from my family who would fill this earth with justice as it has been filled with oppression.
The similitude of believers in regard to mutual love, affection, fellow-feeling is that of one body; when any limb of it aches, the whole body aches, because of sleeplessness and fever.
Your Lord is munificent and generous, and is ashamed to turn away empty the hands of His servant when he raises them to Him.
If anyone is presented some perfume, he should not return it, for it is a thing of good fragrance and light to bear.
Whoever is deprived of gentleness, he is deprived of goodness.

Whoever finds lost property, let him ask one or two men of good character to witness it, then he should not alter it nor conceal it. If its owner comes along, then he has more right to it, otherwise it belongs to Allah, Who gives it to whomsoever He wills.
You hear, and others will hear from you; and people will hear from them who heard from you.
Love for the Ansar is a sign of faith and hatred for the Ansar is a sign of hypocrisy.
Verily, one of the worst lies is to claim falsely to be the son of someone other than one's real father, or to claim to have had a dream one has not had, or to attribute to me what I have not said.
I forbade you to visit graves, but you may now visit them, for in visiting them there is a reminder.
Paradise has eight gates, and one of them is called Ar-Raiyan through which none will enter but those who observe fasting.
He who is deprived of tenderly feelings is in fact deprived of good and he who is deprived of tenderly feelings is in fact deprived of good.

He who observed the fasts of Ramadan with faith and seeking reward, all his previous sins would be forgiven, and he who observed prayer on Lailat-ul- Qadr with faith and seeking reward, all his previous sins would be forgiven.
Allah does not accept charity from goods acquired by embezzlement as He does not accept prayer without purification.
The people will sweat so profusely on the Day of Resurrection that their sweat will sink seventy cubits deep into the earth, and it will rise up till it reaches the people's mouths and ears.
Richness is not an abundance of worldly goods, rather richness is contentment with one’s lot.
One of the things people have learnt from the words of the earliest prophecy is: If you have no shame, do what you like.

In connection with the people of Hijr: Do not enter but weepingly of these people who had been punished by, and in case you do not feel inclined to weep, then do not enter that you may not meet the same calamity as had fallen to their lot.
He who patiently endures the hardships of it, I would be an intercessor or a withness on his behalf on the Day of Resurrection.
None of you should use the word al-harin for the heart of a believer is karm.
The supplication of every one of you is granted if he does not grow impatient and says: I supplicated but it was not granted.

If Caesar is ruined, there will be no Caesar after him; and if Khosrau is ruined, there will be no Khosrau, after him; and, by Him in Whose Hand my soul is, surely you will spend their treasures in Allah's Cause.
The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday; on it Adam was created, on it he was made to enter Paradise, on it he. was expelled from it.
The believer is not afflicted by the prick of a thorn or what is worse than that, except that by it Allah raises him in rank and removes sin from him.
Fasting the day of ‘Ashura’, I hope, will expiate for the sins of the previous year.
None of you should lie on his back and place one of his feet upon the other.
No one of you should refuse to let his neighbor fix a piece of wood to his wall.
Whoever fasts one day in the cause of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, Allah will separate his face from the fire by seventy years.
When any one of you leads people in prayer, he must shorten it for among them are the weak, the infirm and those who have business to attend.

An honest Muslim storekeeper who carries out the orders of his master and pays fully what he has been ordered to give with a good heart and pays to that person to whom he was ordered to pay, is regarded as one of the two charitable persons.

Verily Allah likes three things for you and He disapproves three things for you. He is pleased with you that you worship Him and associate nor anything with Him, that you hold fast the rope of Allah, and be not scattered; and He disapproves for you irrelevant talk, persistent questioning ane the wasting of wealth.
He who is not merciful to others, will not be treated mercifully.
The son of Adam grows old, but two in him remain young: desire for wealth and desire for life.
There are two blessings that many people are deceived into losing: health and free time.
When a Muslim spends something on his family intending to receive Allah's reward it is regarded as Sadaqa for him.
Between my house and my pulpit there is a garden from amongst the gardens of Paradise, and my pulpit is over my Lake-Fount.
Among the inhabitants of the Fire Abu Talib would have the least suffering, and he would be wearing two shoes which would boil his brain.
He who is presented with a flower should not reject it, for it is light to carry and pleasant in odour.

Whoever established prayers on the night of Qadr out of sincere faith and hoping for a reward from Allah, then all his previous sins will be forgiven; and whoever fasts in the month of Ramadan out of sincere faith, and hoping for a reward from Allah, then all his previous sins will be forgiven.
The servant Allah conceals in this world, Allah would also conceal on the Day of Resurrection.

The Ansar are my near companions to whom I confided my private secrets, People will go on increasing but the Ansar will go on decreasing; so accept the good of the good-doers amongst them and excuse the wrong-doers amongst them.

When Allah has a good purpose for a ruler, He appoints for him a sincere minister who reminds him if he forgets and helps him if he remembers; but when Allah has a different purpose from that for him. He appoints for him an evil minister who does not remind him if he forgets and does not help him if he remembers.

I have five names: I am Muhammad and Ahmad; I am Al-Mahi through whom Allah will eliminate infidelity; I am Al-Hashir who will be the first to be resurrected, the people being resurrected there after; and I am also Al-`Aqib.
A neighbour has the best claim to the house or land of the neighbour.
Traveling is a kind of torture, as it prevents one from sleeping and eating! So when one has finished his job, he should return quickly to his family.
On the day of the conquest of Makkah: There is no emigration, but only Jihad and some intention. So when you are summoned to go forth, go forth.

On the Day of Judgment there will be a flag for every person guilty of the breach of faith. It will be raised in proportion to the extent of his guilt; and there is no guilt of treachery more serious than the one committed by the ruler of men.
No one should prepare a mount to visit any mosque except three: the Sacred Mosque, this mosque of mine, and Aqsa Mosque.
This heat is from the exhalation of Hell-fire, so delay the prayer till it is cool.

When one of you dies he is shown his place morning and evening. If he is one of the people of paradise them he is one of the people of Paradise, and if he is one of the people of Hell, then he is one of the people of Hell, until Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, raises him up on the Day of Resurrection.

Help your brother whether he is an oppressor or an oppressed," A man said, "O Allah's Apostle! I will help him if he is oppressed, but if he is an oppressor, how shall I help him?" The Prophet said, "By preventing him from oppressing, for that is how to help him.
Cover the utensils, close the doors, and put out the lights, lest the evil creature should pull away the wick and thus burn the people of the house.
He who commits suicide by throttling shall keep on throttling himself in the Hell Fire and he who commits suicide by stabbing himself shall keep on stabbing himself in the Hell-Fire.
Charity given to the poor is charity, and that given to a relative is two things: charity and upholding the ties of kinship.
Trim closely the moustache, and grow beard, and thus act against the fire-worshippers.
There is no infection, no hamah, no other promising rain, and no serpent in a hungry belly.
The dream of a believer is one of the forty-six parts of prophecy.
The people will continue to keep themselves away from the front row until Allah will keep them away in the Hell-fire.
Charity does not decrease wealth, no one forgives another except that Allah increases his honor, and no one humbles himself for the sake of Allah except that Allah raises his status.

A good dream is from Allah, and a bad dream is from Satan. So if anyone of you sees something he dislikes, when he gets up he should blow thrice and seek refuge with Allah from its evil for then it will not harm him.
Nothing is more loveable to Allah than His praise as He has praised Himself and no one is more self-respecting than Allah Himself and it As because of this that He has prohibited abominable acts.
None plots against the people of Medina but that he will be dissolved like the salt is dissolved in water.
By his good character a believer will attain the degree of one who prays during the night and fasts during the day.

He who believes in Allah and the Last Day should do good to his neighbour and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day should show hospitality to the guest and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day should either speak good or better remain silent.
How good is the believers meal of dates shortly before dawn.
Whoever is not grateful to the people, he is not grateful to Allah.
A neighbor has the best claim to the house or land of the neighbor.

Everyone who dies will have fully complete his action, except one who is on the frontier, for his deeds will be made to go on increasing till the Day of Resurrection, and he will be safe from the trial in the grave.

May I not inform you about the inmates of Paradise? said: Every meek person who is considered to be humble and if they were to adjure in the name of Allah, Allah would certainly fulfil it. May I not inform you about the inmates of Hell-Fire? They are all proud, mean and haughty.
Indeed Ash-Shaitan has despaired of getting those who perform Salat to worship him.But he is engaged in sowing hatred among them.
The injuries caused by the best are without liability, and wells are without liability, and mines are without liability, and the Khumus is due on Rikaz.

When Allah's Messenger ﷺ visited the sick he would say: Lord of the people. remove the disease, cure him, for Thou art the great Curer, there is no cure but through Thine healing Power, which leaves nothing of the disease.

You bring to me, for your disputes, some of you perhaps being more eloquent in their plea than others, so I give judgment on their behalf according to what I hear from them. if I slice off anything for him from the right of his brother, he should not accept that, for I sliced off for him a portion from the Hell.

A servant says, My wealth. my wealth, but out of his wealth three things are only his: whatever he eats and makes use of or by means of which he dresses himself and it wears out or he gives as charity, and this is what he stored for himself, and what is beyond this because you are to depart and leave it for other people.
Three things cannot be denied to anyone: water, pasture and fire.

Our lord gets down every night to the heaven of this world when a third night remains and says: who prays to Me so that I may accept his prayer? who asks of Me so that I may give him? who asks for my forgiveness so that I may forgive him?
If any ruler having the authority to rule Muslim subjects dies while he is deceiving them, Allah will forbid Paradise for him.

Some people will come out of the Fire after they have received a touch of the Fire, changing their color, and they will enter Paradise, and the people of Paradise will name them 'Al- Jahannamiyin' the Fire people.

He who leads the people in prayer, and he does so at the right time, will receive, as well as those who are led will get. He who delays from the appointed time will be responsible and not those who are led in prayer.
Worthy amongst the successors would be a person who would be called Uwais. He would have his mother and he would have sign of leprosy. Ask him to beg pardon for you.

By the One in Whose hand is my soul, if one of you were to take a rope and gather firewood on his back that would be better for him than coming to a man to whom Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, has given of His bounty and asking him. Which he may or may not give.

Do good deeds properly, sincerely and moderately and know that your deeds will not make you enter Paradise, and that the most beloved deed to Allah is the most regular and constant even if it were little.
Indeed, anyone who fasts for one day for Allah's Pleasure, Allah will keep his face away from the fire for seventy years.
None of you should wish for death. Either he is a doer of good, so perhaps he may do more good, or he is an evildoer but perhaps he will give up his evil ways.
If the people were given according to their claims, they would claim the lives of persons and their properties, but the oath must be taken by the defendant.
Allah will not be merciful to those who are not merciful to mankind.

If Allah wants to do good to a person, He makes him comprehend the religion. I am just a distributor, but the grant is from Allah. that this nation will keep on following Allah's teachings strictly and they will not be harmed by any one going on a different path till Allah's order is established.
The dream of a faithful believer is a part of the forty-six parts of prophetism.

It is not lawful for a Muslim to desert his brother Muslim for more than three days while meeting, one turns his face to one side and the other turns his face to the other side. Lo! The better of the two is the one who starts greeting the other.
May Allah forgive Lot: He wanted to have a powerful support.
If the son of Adam had two valleys of money, he would wish for a third, for nothing can fill the belly of Adam's son except dust, and Allah forgives him who repents to Him.
Both in this world and in the Hereafter, I am the nearest of all the people to Jesus, the son of Mary. The prophets are paternal brothers; their mothers are different, but their religion is one.
Three days before his death: None of you should die but hoping only good from Allah, the Exalted and Glorious.
Verily, the Satan has lost all hopes that the worshippers would ever worship in the peninsula of Arabia, but he that he would sow the seed of dissension amongst them.

Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should not hurt his neighbor and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should serve his guest generously and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should speak what is good or keep silent.
I am most akin to Jesus Christ among the whole of mankind, and all the Prophets are of different mothers but belong to one religion and no Prophet was raised between me and Jesus.

The most beloved fast to Allah is the fast of Dawud, for he used to fast one day and not the next. And the most beloved of prayer to Allah is the prayer of Dawud; he used to sleep half of the night, pray one-third of the night and sleep one-sixth of the night.
If Allah does not fructify them, then what is permissible for one of you to take the wealth of his brother?
You have to obey when you feel energetic and when you feel tired, during your ease and your hardship, and when others are preferred over you.
He who patiently endured the hardships and rigours of, I would be his witness and intercessor on the Day of Resurrection.

When one of you finishes the last tashahhud, he should seek refuge in Allah from four things: the punishment in Hell, the punishment in the grave, the trail of life and death, and the evil of Antichrist.

None of you should say: 'O Allah, forgive me if You wish; O Allah, be merciful to me if You wish,' but he should always appeal to Allah with determination, for nobody can force Allah to do something against His Will.
If anyone acquires knowledge that should be sought seeking the Face of Allah, but he acquires it only to get some worldly advantage, he will not experience the arf, i.e. the fragrance, of Paradise.
Allah will not accept the excuse of any person whose instant of death is delayed till he is sixty years of age.
If Allah sends punishment upon a nation then it befalls upon the whole population indiscriminately and then they will be resurrected according to their deeds.
Indeed in Paradise there is a tree under whose shade a rider can travel for one hundred years without stopping. Recite if you wish: And in shave extended. And water flowing constantly.
None of you will have faith till he wishes for his brother what he likes for himself.
A man used to give loans to the people and used to say to his servant, 'If the debtor is poor, forgive him, so that Allah may forgive us.' So when he met Allah, Allah forgave him.

The similitude of mine and that of the Apostles is that of a person who constructed a building and he built it fine and well and the people went round it saying: Never have we seen a building more imposing than this. but for one brick, and I am that brick.
Whoever does not give up false statements, and evil deeds, and speaking bad words to others, Allah is not in need of his leaving his food and drink.

Do not hate each other; do not envy each other; do not desert each other; and be the servants of Allah as brethren. It is not allowed for a Muslim to keep apart from his brother for more than three days.
Anyone whose feet are covered with dust in Allah's cause, shall be saved by Allah from the Hell-Fire.

For those who fast there is a gate in Paradise called Ar-Rayyan, through which no one but they will enter. When the last of them has entered it, it will be closed. Whoever enters through it will drink, and whoever drinks will never thirst again.
My intercession will be for those of my people who have committed major sins.
The signs of a hypocrite are three: Whenever he speaks, he tells a lie; and whenever he promises, he breaks his promise; and whenever he is entrusted, he betrays.
Don't have estranged relations and don't nurse enmity and don't enter into a transaction when the other and be fellow-brothers and servants of Allah.

We have been made to excel people in three: Our rows have been made like the rows of the angels and the whole earth has been made a mosque for us, and its dust has been made a purifier for us in case water is not available. And he mentioned another characteristic too.

None has more sense of ghaira than Allah, and for this He has forbidden shameful sins whether committed openly or secretly, and none loves to be praised more than Allah does, and this is why He Praises Himself.

When any one of you drops a mouthful he should pick it up and remove any of the filth on it, and then eat it, and should not leave it for the Satan, and should not wipe his hand with towel until he has licked his fingers, for he does not know in what portion of the food the blessing lies.

Verily! 70,000 or 700,000 of my followers will enter Paradise altogether; so that the first and the last amongst them will enter at the same time, and their faces will be glittering like the bright full moon.
Father's sister should not be combined with her brother's daughter, nor the daughter of a sister with her mother's sister.

When carried to his grave, a dead person is followed by three, two of which return and one remains with him: his relative, his property, and his deeds follow him; relatives and his property go back while his deeds remain with him.

No one of you should wish for death for any calamity that befalls him, but he should say: O Allah! cause me to live so long as my life is better for me; and cause me to die where death is better for me.

It is not allowable for a Muslim to keep apart from his brother for more than three days. When they meet, this turns away from him, and that turns away from him. The better of the two is the one who initiates in salutation.

When one of you leads the people in prayer then let him be brief, for indeed here are among them the young and the old, the weak and the ill. When one of you prays alone, then let him pray as he wishes.
He who ate seven 'ajwa' dates in the morning, poison and magic will not harm him on that day.
None of you would get into Paradise because of his good deeds alone, and he would not be rescued from Fire, not even I, but because of the Mercy of Allah.
An honest treasurer who gives what he is ordered to give fully, perfectly and willingly to the person to whom he is ordered to give, is regarded as one of the two charitable persons.
When any one of you gets up at night and his tongue falters in of the Qar'an, and he does not know what he is reciting, he should go to sleep.

If anyone of you saw a dream which he liked, then that was from Allah, and he should thank Allah for it and tell it to others; but if he saw something else, i.e, a dream which he did not like, then that is from Satan and he should seek refuge with Allah from it and should not tell it to anybody for it will not harm him.
Verily, when a Muslim visits his brother in Islam he is supposed to remain in the fruit garden of Paradise until he returns.
When one of you leads the people in prayer, he should be brief, for among them are the sick, the aged and the needy.
Whoever disapproves of something done by his ruler then he should be patient, for whoever disobeys the ruler even a little will die as those who died in the Pre-lslamic Period of Ignorance..
The sign of Belief is to love the Ansar, and the sign of hypocrisy is to hate the Ansar.
Indeed the Muslim remains in the Khurfah of Paradise while he visits his brother Muslim.

If a person embraces Islam sincerely, then Allah shall forgive all his past sins, and after that starts the settlement of accounts, the reward of his good deeds will be ten times to seven hundred times for each good deed and one evil deed will be recorded as it is unless Allah forgives it.

Shall I tell you of the people of Paradise? They comprise every poor humble person, and if he swears by Allah to do something, Allah will fulfill it; while the people of the fire comprise every violent, cruel arrogant person.

Give Sadaqa for a time is about to come when a person would walk with alms and the one whom it is to be given would say: Had you brought it yesterday, I would have accepted it. For the present I do not need it. I would not find anyone to accept it.
He who intends to do harm to the people of Medina, Allah would efface him just as water dissolves salt.
Recite the Qur'an as long as your hearts agree to do so, and when you feel variance between them, then get up.
There is no sin more deserving that Allah hasten the punishment in this world, in addition to what is stored up for him in the Hereafter – than injustice and severing the ties of kinship.

There had been among the people before you inspired persons and if there were any such among my Umma Umar b. Khattab would be one of them. Ibn Wahb explained the word Muhaddathun as those who receive hint from the High.
They say Al-Karm, and in fact Al-Karm is the heart of a believer.
O God, there is no life, but the life of the Hereafter, So forgive Thou the Ansar and the Muhajirs.

Towards the west there is an open door, seventy years wide. That door will remain open for repentance until the sun rises from this direction. When it rises from this direction, faith will not benefit any soul that did not believe before or earn anything good through its faith.
When I start the prayer I intend to prolong it, but on hearing the cries of a child, I cut short the prayer because I know that the cries of the child will incite its mother's passions.

The poor person is not the one who goes round the people and ask them for a mouthful or two or a date or two but the poor is that who has not enough to satisfy his needs and whose condition is not known to others, that others may give him something in charity, and who does not beg of people.
Whoever has a mustard seed's weight of pride in his heart, shall not be admitted into Paradise. And whoever has a mustard seed's weight of faith in his heart, shall not be admitted into the Fire.

There is no envy except in two: a person whom Allah has given wealth and he spends it in the right way, and a person whom Allah has given wisdom and he gives his decisions accordingly and teaches it to the others.

He who believes in Allah and in the last day should honour his guest; he who believes in Allah and in the last day should not harm his neighbor; he who believes in Allah and in the last day should speak good or keep silence.

He who has land should cultivate it, but if he does not find it possible to cultivate it, or finds himself helpless to do so, he should lend it to his Muslim brother, but he should not accept rent from him.
When Allah created the creation, He ordained for Himself and this document is with Him: Verily, My mercy predominates Mv wrath.

There is no trouble that comes to a believer except that it obliterates from his sins, even if it is the pricking of a thorn.
The son of Adam grows old but two things remain young in him: His craving for wealth and his craving for a long life.

Some people will be scorched by Hell as a punishment for sins they have committed, and then Allah will admit them into Paradise by the grant of His Mercy. These people will be called, 'Al-Jahannamiyyin'.
The slaughter of embryo is included when its mother is slaughtered.
I was thinking of not accepting gifts except from a Quraishi, an Ansari, a Thaqafi or a Dawsi.
Whoever desires an expansion in his sustenance and age, should keep good relations with his Kith and kin.
There would be left some space in Paradise as Allah would like that to be left. Then Allah would create another creation as He would like.
None of you should say to Allah: O Allah, grant me mercy, if thou so likest. The supplication should conviction, for Allah is the Doer of He likes to do, and there is none to force Him.
Whoever covers a Muslim, Allah will cover him in this world and in the Hereafter.
None of you should say: ‘O Allah forgive me if You wish. O Allah have mercy on me if You wish.’ Let him be firm in asking, for there is none that can compel Him to do things.
If anyone visits a sick whose time has not come, and says with him seven times: I ask Allah, the Mighty, the Lord of the mighty Throne, to cure you, Allah will cure him from that disease.

The angels descend, the clouds and mention this or that matter decreed in the Heaven. The devils listen stealthily to such a matter, come down to inspire the soothsayers with it, and the latter would add to it one-hundred lies of their own.

Every Prophet was given miracles because of which people believed, but what I have been given, is Divine Inspiration which Allah has revealed to me. So I hope that my followers will outnumber the followers of the other Prophets on the Day of Resurrection.
Any Muslim who has lost three of his children will not be touched by the Fire except that which will render Allah's oath fulfilled.

Whoever believes in the Last Day, let him treat his neighbour well. Whoever believes in Allah and Last Day, let him honor his guest. Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him say something good or else remain silent.

The Similitude of a believer is that of crop which the air continues to toss from one side to another; in the same way a believer always of misfortune. The similitude of a hypocrite is that of a cypress tree which does not move until it is uprooted.
Hurry up with the dead body for if it was righteous, you are forwarding it to welfare; and if it was otherwise, then you are putting off an evil thing down your necks.
When a man was walking on the road, he found a thorny branch and removed it. Allah appreciated his action by forgiving him.
Whoever swears a false oath in order to seize the wealth of a Muslim unlawfully, he will meet Allah when He is angry with him.

He who intended to do good, but did not do it, one good was recorded for him, and he who intended to do good and also did it, ten to seven hundred good deeds were recorded for him. And he who intended evil, but did not commit it, no entry was made against his name, but if he committed that, it was recorded.

A lady was punished because of a cat which she had imprisoned till it died. She entered the Fire because of it, for she neither gave it food nor water as she had imprisoned it, nor set it free to eat from the vermin of the earth.

Leave me as I leave you, for the people who were before you were ruined because of their questions and their differences over their prophets. So, if I forbid you to do something, then keep away from it. And if I order you to do something, then do of it as much as you can.
The best of charity is that which is given when you are self-sufficient, and the upper hand is better than the lower hand, and start with those for whom you are responsible.
The one who looks after a widow and a poor person is like the Mujahid in the cause of Allah, or like the one who fasts all the day and stands all the night.

The Last Hour will not come till wealth is abundant and overflowing, so much so that the owner of the property will think as to who will accept Sadaqa from him, and a person would be called to accept Sadaqa and he would say: I do not need it.

I saw during the night that which a person sees during the sleep as if we are in the house of `Uqba b. Rafi` that there was brought to us the fresh dates of Ibn Tab. I interpreted it as the sublimity for us in the world and good ending in the Hereafter and that our religion is good.
The one who is proficient with the Qur'an will be with the noble and righteous scribes, and the one who reads it and stumbles over it, finding it difficult, will have two rewards.
If the son of Adam had two valleys of wealth, he would love to have a third along with them. Nothing could satisfy him except dust. And Allah accepts the repentance of the one who repents.
I saw Moses, Jesus and Abraham. Jesus was of red complexion, curly hair and a broad chest. Moses was of brown complexion, straight hair and tall stature as if he was from the people of Az-Zutt.
The worst of the people is a man who is double-faced; he presents one face to some and another to others.
The Last Hour will not come until people vie with one another about mosques.
There is no man whose two daughters reach the age of puberty and he treats them kindly for the time they are together, but they will gain him admittance to Paradise.
The part of an Izar which hangs below the ankles is in the Fire.
No Muslim whose three children died will go to the Fire except for Allah's oath.

My example and your example is that of a person who lit the fire and insects and moths began to fall in it and he would be making efforts to take them out, and I am going to hold you back from fire, but you are slipping from my hand.

Our Lord, the Blessed and the Exalted, descends every night to the lowest heaven when one-third of the latter part of the night is left, and says: Who supplicates Me so that I may answer him? Who asks Me so that I may give to him? Who asks Me forgiveness so that I may forgive him?
People who get up from an assembly in which they did not remember Allah will be just as if they had got up from an ass's corpse, and it will be a cause of grief to them.
He has succeeded who is guided to Islam and is granted sufficient provision and is content with it.
There is never any obscenity in a thing, but it mars it, and there is never any modesty in a thing, but it adorns it.
None of you will have faith till he loves me more than his father, his children and all mankind.
At the end of time there will be people who will use this black dye like the crops of doves who will not experience the fragrance of Paradise.
When any one of you leads the people in prayer, he should be brief for among them are the young and the aged, the weak and the sick. But when one of you prays by himself, he may as he likes.

The honest Muslim trustee who spends what he is commanded to do and he gives that in full with his heart overflowing with cheerfulness and he gives it to one to whom he is ordered, he is one of the givers of charity.
It is not permissible for a Muslim to have estranged relations with his brother beyond three days.
Every child is born with a true faith of Islam and his parents convert him to Judaism or Christianity or Magianism, as an animal delivers a perfect baby animal. Do you find it mutilated?

Name yourselves after me, but do not call yourselves by my Kuniya, and whoever sees me in a dream, he surely sees me, for Satan cannot impersonate me. And whoever intentionally ascribes something to me falsely, he will surely take his place in the Fire.
He who leaves the Friday prayer for three Friday on account of slackness, Allah will print a stamp on his heart.

The best people are those of my generation, and then those who will come after them, and then those who will come after them, and then after them, there will come people whose witness will precede their oaths, and whose oaths will precede their witness.

Beware, the fanged beast of prey is not lawful, nor the domestic asses, nor the find from the property of a man with whom treaty has been concluded, except that he did not need it. If anyone is a guest of people who provide no hospitality for him, he is entitled to take from them the equivalent of the hospitality due to him.

People will be struck unconscious on the Day of Resurrection and I will be the first to regain consciousness, and behold! There I will see Moses holding one of the pillars of Allah's Throne. I will wonder whether he has become conscious before me of he has been exempted, because of his unconsciousness at the Tur which he received.
When Allah intends to chastise a people, He chastises all of them then they would be raised according to their deeds.
The further one is from the mosque, the greater will be one's reward.
If anyone asks Allah for martyrdom sincerely, Allah will make him reach the ranks of martyrs even if he died on his bed.
He who came to this House, and neither spoke indecently nor did he act wickedly. would return as on the his mother bore him.
A brother of yours has died, so stand up and offer prayer over him. So we stood up and drew ourselves up into two rows.
Facilitate things to people, and do not make it hard for them and give them good tidings and do not make them run away.
The worst people in the Sight of Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be the double faced people who appear to some people with one face and to other people with another face.
The faithful trustee who gives what he is commanded completely and in full with a good will, and delivers it to the one whom he was told to give it, is one of the two who gives sadaqah.

The example of a believer is that of a fresh tender plant, which the wind bends lt sometimes and some other time it makes it straight. And the example of a hypocrite is that of a pine tree which keeps straight till once it is uprooted suddenly.
Whomever takes an oath in which he mentions Lat and `Uzza, should say: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and whoever says to his companion. 'Come along, let us gamble' must give alms.

If anyone summons other to follow right guidance, his reward will be equivalent to that of the people who follow him, without their rewards being diminished in any respect on that account; and if anyone summons others to follow error the sin of which sins being diminished in any respect on that account.
The most beloved of names to Allah are 'Abdullah and 'Abdur-Rahman.
The omen is polytheistic deed and anyone of us may think he sees an omen but Allah will dispel it by means of relying upon Him.
A single endeavor in Allah's Cause in the forenoon or in the afternoon is better than the world and whatever is in it.
He Is successful who has accepted Islam, who has been provided with sufficient for his want and been made contented by Allah with what He has given him.
None is more patient than Allah against the harmful and annoying words He hears: They ascribe children to Him, yet He bestows upon them health and provision.
I am the nearest of all the people to the son of Mary, and all the prophets are paternal brothers, and there has been no prophet between me and him.

When anyone of you dies, he will be shown his destination both in the morning and in the evening, and if he belongs to the people of Paradise, he will be shown his place in Paradise, and if he is from the people of Hell, he will be shown his place in Hell.
Migration will not end until repentance ends, and repentance will not end until the sun rises in the west.

I would be the first intercessor in the Paradise and no apostle amongst the apostles has been testified as I have been testified. And verily there woald be an apostle among the apostles who would be testified to by only one man from his people.

Seventy thousand or seven hundred thousand of my followers will enter Paradise. They will be holding on to each other, the first will not entering the last one does, their faces like the moon on a full moon night.
Delay in payment by a rich man is injunctive, but when one of you is referred to a wealthy man, he should accept the reference.
The supplication of one of you is granted if he does not grow impatient and say- I supplicated my Lord but it was not granted.
Eat and drink; let not the white and ascending light prevent you from; so eat and drink until the red light spreads horizontally.
Wealth is not in having many possessions, but rather wealth is feeling sufficiency in the soul.
Those who do not show mercy to our young ones and do not realise the right of our elders are not from us.
No fatigue, nor disease, nor sorrow, nor sadness, nor hurt, nor distress befalls a Muslim, even if it were the prick he receives from a thorn, but that Allah expiates some of his sins for that.
narrator: Abu Sa‘id Al-Khudri and Abu Huraira

text: There are no two Muslims, three of whose children die before reaching the age of puberty, but Allah will admit them to Paradise by virtue of His mercy towards them.
When any of you prays and takes off his sandals, he should not harm anyone by them. He should place them between his feet or pray with them on.

Not to wish to be the like of except the like of two: a man whom Allah has given the knowledge of the Qur'an and he recites it during the hours of the night and the hours of the day; and a man whom Allah has given wealth and he spends it during the hours of the night and during the hours of the day.
Whoever guarantees me what is between his legs, and what is between his jaws, I guarantee him Paradise.
Do not swear by your fathers, or by your mothers, or by rivals to Allah; and swear by Allah only, and swear by Allah only when you are speaking the truth.
If I had formerly known what I came to know recently, I would not have driven the Hadi with me and would have finished the state of Ihram along with the people when they finished it.
When the month of Ramadan starts, the gates of the heaven are opened and the gates of Hell are closed and the devils are chained.
There is a tree in Paradise that a fast rider may travel: for one hundred years without being able to cross it.
The people will be assembled on the Day of Resurrection on a white plain with a reddish tinge like the loaf of white bread with no marks set up for anyone.
Whoever has land, let him cultivate it or give it to his brother to cultivate, and not lease it to his brother.
Going out in the morning in the cause of Allah, or in the evening, is better than the world and what is in it.
Allah has revealed to me that you must be humble, so that no one oppresses another and boasts over another.

Avoid suspicion, for suspicion is the gravest lie in talk and do not be inquisitive about one another and do not spy upon one another and do not feel envy with the other, and nurse no malice, and nurse no aversion and hostility against one another. And be fellow-brothers and servants of Allah.
When the month of Ramadan comes, the gates of Paradise are opened and the gates of the Fire are closed, and the devils are chained.
When anyone lands at a place, and then says:" I seek refuge in the Perfect Word of Allah from the evil of what He has created," nothing would harm him until he marches from that stopping place.

Neither nurse mutual hatred, nor jealousy, nor enmity, and become as fellow brothers and servants of Allah. It is not lawful for a Muslim that he should keep his relations estranged with his brother beyond three days.

With Allah the best fasting is that of David and the best prayer is that of David ﷺ for he slept half of the night and stood for prayer for the third of it and slept the sixth part of it and he observed fast one day and broke on the other.
Fever is from the heat of the Fire; so abate fever with water.

Faith has over seventy branches, the most excellent of which is the declaration that there is no god but Allah, and the humblest of which is the removal of a bone from the road. And modesty is a branch of faith.
Whoever says: ‘Glory is to Allah, and with His Praise’ a hundred times, his sins are forgiven, even if they were like the foam of the sea.
No Sadaqa is payable on less than five wasqs of dates or grains.
Whoever takes a oath in order to grab property, then Allah will be angry with him when he will meet Him.
About people who are absent from Jumu'a prayer: I intend that I should command a person to lead people in prayer, and then burn those persons who absent themselves from Jumu'a prayer in their houses.
Ing: He who seeks repentance before the rising of the sun from the west, Allah turns to him with Mercy.
Your children are part of the best of your earnings, so eat from what your children earn.
A true good dream is from Allah, and a bad dream is from Satan.

If anyone of you leads the people in the prayer, he should shorten it for amongst them are the weak, the sick and the old; and if anyone among your prays alone then he may prolong as much as he wishes.

Allah created Adam from a handful which he took from the whole of the earth; so the children of Adam are in accordance with the earth: some red, some white, some black, some a mixture, also smooth and rough, bad and good.
Fatima is a part of me, and whoever makes her angry, makes me angry.
When a man dies, his acts come to an end, but three, recurring charity, or knowledge benefit, or a pious child, who prays for him.
Amongst the apostles I would have the largest following on the Day of Resurrec tion, and I would be the first to knock at the door of Paradise.
A Muslim whose three children die before the age of puberty will be granted Paradise by Allah due to his mercy for them.
Whoever obeys me, obeys Allah, and whoever disobeys me, disobeys Allah, and whoever obeys the ruler I appoint, obeys me, and whoever disobeys him, disobeys me.
